column1: # The schedule: which phase, track or stage owns each pending test (implementation-plan.md §4.3,
# §6). Read by `cargo xtask status` (a report) and `cargo xtask status --schedule` (the check).
# Columns: kind, key, value, reference, note. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# kind=fact    key=stage: the stage the project is in now (an owner id).
#                order=<n>   position in the plan's sequence (display only)
#                from=<id>   a track's first phase; join=<id> the phase it joins at
#                started=<date>  a track's start (absent: not started)
# kind=assign  key=selector; value=owner id, DEFERRAL or UNASSIGNED. The first matching row in
#              file order decides, so specific rows come before section rows. Selectors:
#                §N, §N.M      clauses whose section is N.M or below it; for symbols and libm
#                clause:<glob>[,<glob>...]   clause IDs      sym:<glob>[,...]   symbol names
#                compat-only   symbols with no default version (spec/abi/versions.tsv)
#                group:<stem>  every test in the status group <stem> (a test file's name up to
#              A DEFERRAL names its reference (an owner ruling or a decision row) and its
#              reason in the note; UNASSIGNED marks work the plan gives to nobody.
# The check fails for pending work owned by a phase that is done, by a track that has not
# started or whose join phase is done, or that is UNASSIGNED (or matched by no row).
